name: If Pastor Gets A Divorce And Remarried
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that God hates divorce and views it as a serious breach of the marriage covenant, warning against treachery in marital relationships (Malachi 2:16). Jesus affirms the original design of marriage as a lifelong union between one man and one woman (Matthew 19:4) and states that divorcing a spouse and remarrying, except in the case of sexual immorality, constitutes adultery (Matthew 5:32; 19:9; Mark 10:11). Therefore, for a pastor who divorces and remarries, these passages emphasize the need for careful consideration of God's standards for marriage and faithfulness.
